name: Cubing in Cambridge 2023
information: ### Due to limited venue space, we are encouraging all competitors to bring only one guest at maximum to the competition No COVID restrictions are present for this competition at this time. This will be updated as necessary. **Please read the travel tab before attending the competition, especially if you are travelling by car. This competition is being held in a densely populated area and you cannot park on the streets near the venue. Garages are available nearby**
